/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
import importlib.util
from collections import defaultdict,Counter
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('solver','/app/submissions/solve.py')
mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
inst=mod.Instance(); patterns=mod.generate_patterns(inst)
sel,status,gap=mod.solve_assignment_master(inst,patterns,4.0,20)
# aggregate by station,pod across orders, preserving item quantities
agg=defaultdict(list)
for oid,p in sel.items():
    map=dict(p.line_to_pod)
    for line in inst.order_lines[oid]:
        agg[(p.station_id,map[line['sku_id']])].append((oid,line['sku_id'],line['quantity']))

# pack visits by station,pod, capacity max units, prioritizing due/release maybe not needed for count
poddur=Counter(); podvis=Counter(); stationdur=Counter()
for (st,pod),items in agg.items():
    maxu=int(inst.stations[st]['max_units_per_visit'])
    expanded=[]
    for oid,sku,q in items:
        expanded.extend([(oid,sku)]*q)
    # sort by due then order
    expanded.sort(key=lambda x:(int(inst.orders[x[0]]['due_slot']), x[0], x[1]))
    while expanded:
        chunk=expanded[:maxu]; expanded=expanded[maxu:]
        counts=Counter(sku for oid,sku in chunk)
        service=sum(cnt*int(inst.skus[sku]['unit_pick_time']) for sku,cnt in counts.items())
        travel=inst.loaded_travel_slots(pod,st)
        dur=2*travel+max(1,-(-service//inst.slot_minutes))
        poddur[pod]+=dur
        podvis[pod]+=1
        stationdur[st]+=dur
print('stationdur',dict(stationdur))
